_claim: Origin's pressedOverlay on the panel-header trigger BUTTON itself, not on the menu rows C-6/C-7/C-8 describe. Resolved by Button's own ghost variant, which already carries active:bg-accent active:text-accent-foreground system-wide.
_no_precondition_and_why_that_is_not_an_: This is the ONE row of the four that must be measured with the menu CLOSED. Measured first with ?open=panel-actions and it returned rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) — fully transparent, the active rule never applying. Cause: while the menu is open Radix mounts a dismissable layer that intercepts the pointer, so mousedown never reaches the trigger. Pressing this button with the menu already open is also not a state a user reaches; they press it to OPEN the menu. Measuring it under the precondition would have recorded a real number for a state that does not exist.
